entities.summary: Romania's entry into WWI (August 1916), initial defeats and the loss of Bucharest, the victories at Mărășești (1917), and the post-war unification creating Greater Romania (December 1, 1918 — Transylvania, plus Bukovina and Bessarabia), doubling the country's size.
